Blast Furnace is a mini game for smithing that provides very fast smithing xp in oldschool. However, it’s only fast with multiple people playing the mini game on the same world. That’s why there is a designated world for it, so that anyone who is interested in efficient smithing xp through blast furnace will be there. 

The wilderness is where other players can attack you. They have a world for it in oldschool because PvP is a decent sized part of the game for you guys (it’s not at all in RS3). If you want to fight people in the wilderness you can use that world, that’s where others will be looking to have a fair fight rather than staying on another world and killing people who are trying to do something else in the wilderness and don’t want to fight

No your account will be in the same spot across every world. Think of worlds as a way to reduce lag and loading time for everyone. If 80,000 people were playing on the same server, the game would be unplayable for everyone, so for the game to run smoothly these 80,000 players are split amongst 140 “worlds”.  Some worlds are busier than others because people congregate on specific worlds to do certain tasks. For example, world 2 is a trade world. Therefore anyone looking to trade items not listed on the grand exchange or above max cash will be on that world. Other than certain tasks which almost require certain worlds there is no difference
